dedupe_keys.name: district heating transformation thermo hydraulic simulation dhtranssim

description: District Heating Transformation Thermo-hydraulic Simulation (dhTransSIM) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Institute of Energy Economics and Rational Energy Use (IER); University of Stuttgart. Thermo-hydraulic simulation and followed by performance-oriented assessment of district heating networks. dhTransSIM supports the representation of network operation based on network topology, technical component data, heat-demand profiles and measurement-based boundary conditions. It is used to analyse temperatures, mass flows, heat flows, heat losses and operational deviations in existing or planned district heating networks. Coverage: Germany. Methodical focus: Simulation, Transformation / Decarbonisation, Performance Evaluation. Time resolution: hour, 15 min, 1 min. Spatial resolution: districts, households. Software: Dymola. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
